Our Story

More Than a
Driving School.

Prashant Driving School was founded with one mission: to make every student a confident, safe, and responsible driver. Over 15 years, we have trained thousands of students in Ranala and built a reputation for quality, patience, and results.

Our team of certified instructors doesn't just teach traffic rules — we build your instincts, your confidence, and your respect for road safety. We also provide a driving simulator for beginners to practice safely before hitting the road.

FAQ

Questions
Answered.

Everything you need to know before you start your journey with us.

Most beginners are road-ready in 24 sessions. This depends on your pace and comfort. We never rush — your safety always comes first.
Yes! We train students on both petrol and diesel cars. We also have manual and automatic transmission options available so you are prepared for any vehicle.
Our driving simulator lets complete beginners practice vehicle controls, road scenarios, and reactions in a completely safe environment — before they step into a real car. It builds initial confidence fast.
Yes, we provide complete RTO assistance — from paperwork to test preparation. Our instructors accompany you on your RTO test day and prepare you for exactly what to expect.
Yes. All vehicle insurance and PUC (Pollution Under Control) certifications are managed at our school. We are a one-stop solution for all your driving and vehicle needs.
We operate 6 Days a week. You can call us at 9765236796 to confirm current available time slots. We work around your schedule.
